sources.title: Introducing Claude 4
sources.evidence: May 22, 2025 public launch explicitly names Claude Sonnet 4, offers standard and extended-thinking modes, parallel tool use, coding, and agent workflows. Reopened October 27, 2026. The release describes Sonnet 4 capabilities and compares it with Sonnet 3.7, but supplies no nominal total/active count or named publicly sized base. Original release facts above remain supported.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 4 & Claude Sonnet 4
sources.evidence: Introduction and section 1.1 identify Anthropic as developer and describe reasoning, visual analysis, coding and tool use. Section 1.1.2 explicitly describes optional extended thinking. Full PDF retrieved and searched with pdftotext; no production-model total or active parameter count disclosed. Fresh October 27 re-audit independently read the original card from the parent's same-day retrieval cache. Section 1.1 describes pretraining and post-training but gives no numeric model size or sized-base identity. Full-text count searches found no total/active disclosure; numeric comparisons are capability or safety measurements.

sources.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
sources.evidence: Methods explicitly includes production Sonnet 4 separately from helpful-only variants, with residual-stream interventions across layers. The paper discusses transformer-based models and attention heads. Supports broad Transformer classification, but gives no dense/MoE topology or production parameter count; normalized layer positions are not actual layer counts. Reopened October 27, 2026. Its Methods explicitly identifies helpful-only variants as sharing their corresponding production model's pretrained base, but does not publish the base's parameter count. Layer positions are normalized; intervention strengths and feature directions are not model sizes.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial API access is subject to use restrictions including reverse engineering and duplication restrictions, with no general transfer of intellectual-property rights. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification, not a downloadable-weight license.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Used for Claude-wide distribution policy only, not Sonnet 4 technical specifications.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes
sources.evidence: August 12, 2025 entry introduced Sonnet 4 1M context beta. April 30, 2026 entry explicitly retires that beta for Sonnet 4 and states that requests beyond the standard 200k context return an error on the Claude API.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4 - Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Exact dated Bedrock ID anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0; 200K context, text/image inputs, text output, reasoning and client-side tool calling. States end of life on October 14, 2026. Its provider-specific May 23 launch date does not supersede Anthropic public launch on May 22. Reopened October 27, 2026 for exact snapshot specifications; no total or active model count appears.

sources.title: Citations API and PDF support for Claude models now in Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: June 30, 2025 announcement explicitly lists Claude Sonnet 4 for PDF processing with text extraction and visual document analysis through Invoke Model and Converse APIs.

sources.title: System Card Addendum: Claude Opus 4.1
sources.evidence: Full PDF searched, including exact Sonnet 4 comparison in table 5.B and the comparative-evaluation discussion. These are capability/safety comparisons and do not disclose Sonnet 4 total or active parameters. Independently rechecked October 27 using the same-day cache retrieved through Anthropic's official Opus 4.1 system-card URL. Exact Sonnet 4 rows in Table 5.B are reward-hacking percentages, not parameter counts; full-text searches found no total or active count.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Sonnet 4.5
sources.evidence: Retrieved complete PDF via curl and pdftotext after the web tool rejected its size. Inspected model-characteristics section and exact Sonnet 4 comparison tables such as table 2.1.1.A; searched parameter, architecture, dense, MoE and billion/trillion terms. No Sonnet 4 total or active parameter count is disclosed. Independently rechecked October 27 using the same-day cache retrieved through Anthropic's official Sonnet 4.5 system-card URL. Table 2.1.1.A and other exact Sonnet 4 comparisons report evaluation rates. No total/activated-parameter column or numeric size was found.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Sonnet 4.6
sources.evidence: Full PDF retrieved and searched for parameter counts and architecture disclosures; exact Sonnet 4 occurs as an evaluation grader. No total or active parameter count for Sonnet 4 found, and newer model specifications are not transferred to it. Independently rechecked October 27 from the same-day official-card cache. Sonnet 4 appears as a grading model, without a disclosed size. Full-text searches found no nominal total or active count.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Maps Claude Sonnet 4 to claude-sonnet-4-20250514 and records retirement on the Claude API on June 15, 2026.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4 on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Retrieved indexed provider documentation lists text/code/image inputs, text output, function calling and extended thinking; lists 200,000 GA and 1M Preview input limits. Subsequent direct opens returned 404, so this retained documentation does not establish present endpoint operation or continued preview availability.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 summary
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. The exact-model summary describes training, capabilities, modalities and release safeguards, but publishes no nominal total or active count. References to pretraining do not name a publicly sized base.

sources.title: Teaching Claude why
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026. The May 8, 2026 research describes RL experiments using the base underlying Claude Sonnet 4, establishing an exact-model research connection. It does not publish that base's parameter count; training-mixture and environment differences do not supply a size.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected October 27 from the parent's same-day official-PDF cache. Exact Sonnet 4 searches and count/activated-parameter searches yielded no count or size-bearing lineage for the audited snapshot; later-model descriptions are not transferred.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected October 27 from the parent's same-day official-PDF cache. This later first-party card supplies no exact Sonnet 4 total/active comparison column or count-bearing base relationship.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4 - InferenceBench numeric lead
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 solely to resolve a fresh numeric lead. The page asserts 70B total and 70B active with detailed dense geometry, but provides no count-specific developer source. Its official release link supplies no such figure, and its hardware/self-hosting estimates are not measurements of Anthropic weights. No catalog specification is based on this unsupported secondary assertion.

sources.title: InferenceBench methodology
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 while tracing the 70B lead. Describes roofline throughput and memory calculations using model size as an input, but gives no provenance or measurement establishing Sonnet 4's input size.

sources.title: Anthropic and xAI Model Parameter Counts - numeric lead resolution
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 as a secondary lead. The April 9 article attributes a 1T figure to an Elon Musk statement about unspecified Sonnet. It identifies neither the Sonnet 4 snapshot nor any active count, and is not an Anthropic disclosure. No size is transferred to this exact model.

name.note: Official launch name; deprecation documentation identifies the exact dated API snapshot.

developer.note: Explicitly identified as the developer in the original system card.

family.note: Normalized catalog family for the official Claude Sonnet model line.

release_date.note: Public release date in the original announcement. The 20250514 snapshot suffix and provider-specific launch dates are not the first public release date.

open_weights.note: The exact model launched through hosted products; Anthropic explicitly states the Claude-wide policy that weights are not released or provided to users.

license.note: Descriptive classification of restricted commercial access; not an SPDX or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 release, exact-card, interpretability, training-research and later comparison checks found no developer-published nominal total or size-bearing base lineage. Research explicitly identifies Sonnet 4 base and helpful-only variants, but leaves their sizes unpublished. The 70B numeric lead has no count-specific primary source; the 1T remark refers to unspecified Sonnet. Null reflects missing supported nominal evidence, not a requirement for exact tensor counting.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 check independently searched active/activated parameters and later first-party tables. Exact Sonnet 4 comparison rows report safety or capability results, with no activated-parameter column. The secondary 70B-active claim supplies no developer basis. Broad Transformer structure, normalized layers and post-training relationships do not establish an active count, and equality with total is not assumed.

architecture.note: Broad classification supported by the study of exact production Sonnet 4 with layer residual-stream interventions and transformer/attention discussion. Dense versus MoE, actual layer depth and production parameter counts remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Retains the documented standard 200K context. Sonnet 4 previously offered 1M beta, retired on the Claude API on April 30, 2026. Retained Google documentation still lists 1M Preview/200K GA; current preview availability was not established. This field is the standard specification, not the greatest historical or provider-preview limit.

modalities.note: Text/image inputs and text output are explicit in the exact provider card; PDF is a documented supported input format, not a separate native sensory modality.

reasoning.note: Optional extended-thinking mode is explicitly documented; this is not inferred merely from chain-of-thought prompting.

tool_call.note: Launch announcement explicitly documents parallel tool use, and the exact provider card lists client-side tool calling.

description.note: Neutral summary of supported model capabilities, replacing vague cost-control positioning.

patch.description: Claude hybrid reasoning model for coding, visual analysis, and agent workflows
patch.notes: Production Sonnet 4 interpretability research supports broad Transformer structure; dense/MoE topology and nominal total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Research identifies its pretrained base but does not publish its size. PDF is a supported document input format. The standard context is 200K; the 1M beta launched August 12, 2025 and was retired on the Claude API April 30, 2026. Retained Google documentation lists 1M Preview/200K GA, but current preview operation was not verified. The dated model retired from the Claude API June 15, 2026 and reached Bedrock end of life October 14, 2026. Historical specifications do not establish current endpoint availability.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh original-source, interpretability, named-base research and later first-party comparison checks. Resolved the 70B total/active claim as lacking count-specific primary support and the 1T claim as referring to unspecified Sonnet. Exact base relationships exist but no published nominal size was found. All unrelated assessments, historical context qualifications and retirement facts are preserved.
